name: WhatsApp Receipt Intake
description: Lightweight WhatsApp webhook intake: validates that the message carries a photo, drops one job file into queue/ referencing the receipt image, and immediately acknowledges the sender. Does NO heavy work so it returns fast and never blocks. The drainer workflow processes the queue asynchronously.

nodes.name: Has photo?
nodes.description: Only enqueue if the WhatsApp message actually carried media.

nodes.name: Build job
nodes.description: Capture who sent it, the receipt image path (in the shared wa-media volume), and a unique id so two photos in the same second never collide.

nodes.name: Enqueue job
nodes.description: Write one JSON job file into queue/. Filename is sortable by timestamp (FIFO) and uniquified by uid.

nodes.name: Acknowledge
nodes.description: Instant feedback to the sender that the receipt was received and queued.

config.text: Receipt received ✅ — queued for processing. I'll send you the details shortly.

nodes.name: Ask for a photo
nodes.description: No media on the message — tell the user to attach a receipt photo.

config.text: I didn't find a photo in that message. Please send a picture of the receipt and I'll process it.
